$description: Rhythm / position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Each rule has severity error|warn and named exceptions. Every rule id is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py (RULES); verify_all.py fails if the two lists diverge. Each rule was checked against the real node sequences in templates/templates.json when it was written.

rules.description: The first node must be hero.episode: there is no navbar before it (the only element above the headline is the logo inside the hero).

exceptions.reason: Legal pages are hero-less; legal.header is first.

rules.description: hero.episode must not appear on a legal page.
closing.cta is the last content section and sits immediately before chrome.footer.

exceptions.reason: Legal pages have no closing CTA.

rules.description: Every section contract declares onePerPage; no section repeats on a page.
rules.checkedAgainst: every node list in templates.json has unique section ids; every sections/*.json has constraints.onePerPage true

rules.description: chrome.footer comes after every content section; only overlays may follow it.
rules.checkedAgainst: both templates end with chrome.footer then overlays

rules.description: overlay.* nodes come after chrome.footer (App.jsx renders Page, Footer, DemoDialog, CookieBanner).
rules.checkedAgainst: both templates list overlay nodes after chrome.footer

rules.description: overlay.demo-dialog is listed before overlay.cookie-banner (App.jsx order). Visual stacking is unaffected (both are fixed/top-layer), so a different order is a notice only.
rules.checkedAgainst: both templates list demo-dialog then cookie-banner

rules.description: legal.header is the first node and legal.body immediately follows it.
Any CTA whose href is #demo needs overlay.demo-dialog on the page (a document-level click handler on a[href="#demo"] opens it).
chrome.footer's Cookies button opens the preferences modal, which lives in overlay.cookie-banner; the footer therefore needs that overlay on the page.

Eyebrows that start with a two-digit section numeral ('NN · ') should not repeat a numeral. The clone's own copy trips this: Integrations (default num 03) and CSR (hard-coded 03) both read 03, so the bundled home example emits one WARN by design.
rules.checkedAgainst: bundled home example produces exactly this one warning

rules.description: A node's section must list the page route in constraints.allowedRoutes (home-only sections cannot appear on legal routes and vice versa).
